summary: Full end-to-end validation of ProfileMenu (Header top-right dropdown) and new /app/billing page. Backend endpoints for subscription status, discord status, and Stripe portal all behave correctly. Fresh registered user returns 400 code=no_customer on /api/payments/portal (as specified). UI: profile menu opens on avatar click, closes on Escape + outside-click, all 6 menu items render, navigation to Billing works, Billing page correctly shows starter-only UI (no open-portal-btn, 'Nessun metodo di pagamento associato' message, upgrade-cta + see-plans-btn visible). Logout via menu-logout redirects to /login and invalidates the server session (subsequent /me returns 401).
critical_code_review_comments: ProfileMenu.jsx fetches /subscriptions/status and /discord/status on every dropdown open (useEffect on 'open'). Consider caching or fetch once per session to avoid repeated calls when user opens the menu multiple times.

Billing.jsx has origin hardcoded as 'https://forgefps.dev' in payments.py return_url (line 152) — this is the production domain and OK for prod, but on preview/staging the Stripe portal would redirect back to prod. Consider using request-origin or env var (e.g. os.environ.get('APP_ORIGIN')).

Console spam: many 402 errors observed during dashboard load (AI Advisor / Emergent LLM key out of budget as noted in the task). Consider hiding failing widgets or showing a graceful error state instead of firing failing requests on mount.
payments.py POST /payments/portal catches all stripe.error.StripeError as 500 with raw str(e) — consider mapping known errors (e.g. customer not found in Stripe) to specific codes/messages for UI.
